items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: It must be since my time, huh? Or how, how, is he an old timer?

ctx.x: Oh, sure. They had many white bands playing. But now, if you ask me the names of them, uh, I would say that maybe the Wooden of the World or some organization similar to that had, uh, had bands. Did they play any jazzies? No, no, they just, they played the dirge. They played a funeral dirge. Uh-huh. Uh, it was, it was the colored bands, really, that, uh, came back, uh, rejoicing from, from the, from the last resting place of their friend. But, uh, I guess the, I guess it's traditional with them. The other bands…
What about, uh, Frankie Doosan, the colored trombone player from Al Jaze? Did you ever hear him? I just wondered.
